purpose: Calibration reference for selecting the dominant parent structure instead of an excessively local nested geometry
issues: Scanner selects an excessively short local structure
Scanner ignores the larger structurally meaningful parent triangle
The parent structure has stronger anchor extrema and broader price-action support
desired_behavior: Prefer meaningful structural anchors over arbitrary locality
Balance freshness against structure span and anchor quality
Reward trendlines supported by pivots distributed across the structure
Avoid selecting a small nested geometry when a stronger parent structure explains the same current price action
notes: Important counterexample to excessive freshness/locality weighting. Preserve for future Triangle Compression calibration, but also use now when designing Geometry Ranking for wedges.
